parts.article_title: Lost, Damaged or Delayed Inland Mail Claim Form

paragraphs.text: Before completing this claim form for lost, damaged or delayed mail you should visit www.royalmail.com to find out all you need to know about our policies.Alternatively you can get the details from our 'Mail Made Easy' booklet, available at any local post office branch. When you fill in the form, make sure you complete it in full, using the checklist that we have provided to help you. If you find that you do not have the evidence required to make a claim but would like us to investigate an issue with your mail service, the easiest way to do this is by visiting our website.
paragraphs.translation:
在填写此份关于遗失、损坏或延误邮件的索赔表之前，您应访问www.royalmail.com以了解我们政策的所有相关信息。
或者，您可以从我们的《邮件轻松办》手册中获取详细信息，该手册可在任何当地邮局分支机构获取。
填写表格时，请确保使用我们提供的核对清单来帮助您完整填写。
如果您发现自己没有提出索赔所需的证据，但希望我们调查您的邮件服务问题，最简单的方法就是访问我们的网站。

paragraphs.text: Lost items
paragraphs.translation: 丢失物品

paragraphs.text: If you wish to claim compensation for lost items, you need to send us original proof of posting, e.g. a Post Office receipt. If claiming for the contents of a package, you also need to provide proof of value,e.g. till item reference number, receipt, bank statement, etc.
paragraphs.translation:
丢失物品
如果您希望就丢失物品申请赔偿，您需要向我们提供原始的邮寄证明，例如邮局收据。
如果就包裹内的物品索赔，您还需要提供价值证明，例如收银机商品参考编号、收据、银行对账单等。

paragraphs.text: Damaged items
paragraphs.translation: 损坏物品

paragraphs.text: When claiming compensation for items that have been damaged, you should send us the items themselves, if possible.However, if these are very large or unsafe to post, you may instead provide photographs as evidence of the damage.Please retain the original packaging (and damaged items, if not sent to us) as we may need to inspect them.
paragraphs.translation:
损坏物品
当申请物品损坏赔偿时，如果可能，您应将物品本身寄送给我们。
然而，如果物品体积过大或邮寄不安全，您可以提供照片作为损坏证据。
请保留原始包装（以及未寄送给我们的损坏物品），因为我们可能需要进行检查。

paragraphs.text: Time restrictions
paragraphs.translation: 时间限制

paragraphs.text: We allow up to 15 working days for items to arrive, so cannot accept a claim for loss unless 15 working days or more have passed since the item was posted.
paragraphs.translation: 我们允许最多15个工作日让物品送达，因此除非自物品寄出后已过去15个工作日或更长时间，否则我们无法受理丢失索赔。

paragraphs.text: Claims for lost or damaged items must be made within 12 months of the postal date. Claims for delayed items must be submitted within 3 months of the date they were posted if the claim is made by the sender, or within 1 month of receipt if the claim is made by the recipient of the item.
paragraphs.translation:
损坏物品
对于丢失或损坏物品的索赔必须在邮寄日期后的12个月内提出。
对于延迟物品的索赔，如果由寄件人提出，则必须在邮寄日期后的3个月内提交；如果由收件人提出，则必须在收到物品后的1个月内提交。

paragraphs.text: Days out for the family
paragraphs.translation: 适合全家人的外出游玩日

paragraphs.text: A Carrickfergus Castle
paragraphs.translation: A 卡里克弗格斯城堡

paragraphs.text: Considered to be Northern Ireland's oldest castle, Carrickfergus has seen more than 800 years of military occupation since its foundations were laid. During summer, traditional feasts are served, and fairs and craft markets provide an extra attraction. The history of the castle is explained and brought to life with exhibits and guided tours.
paragraphs.translation:
卡里克弗格斯城堡被认为是北爱尔兰最古老的城堡，自其地基建成以来，已历经超过800年的军事占领。
夏季期间，这里会提供传统盛宴，而集市和手工艺品市场则增添了额外的吸引力。
通过展品和导览游览，城堡的历史得以讲解并生动呈现。

paragraphs.text: B Glamis Castle
paragraphs.translation: B 格拉姆斯城堡

paragraphs.text: Shakespeare used Glamis as the background when he wrote one of his best-known plays, Macbeth, and the Queen Mother grew up here. It is also rumoured to have a secret chamber in the walls of the castle.There are many ghost tales associated with this castle, which will capture the imagination of younger visitors.
paragraphs.translation:
莎士比亚在创作他最著名的戏剧之一《麦克白》时，以格拉姆斯城堡为背景，而伊丽莎白王太后正是在这里长大的。
此外，有传闻称城堡的墙壁内有一个秘密房间。
与这座城堡相关的众多鬼怪故事会激发年轻游客的想象力。

paragraphs.text: C Tintagel Castle
paragraphs.translation: C 廷塔杰尔城堡

paragraphs.text: High up on the cliff tops,Tintagel Castle is the legendary home of King Arthur. The visitor's guide on sale at the reception is well worth the money, as it can help you to visualise what it would have been like hundreds of years ago. You can park in the village car park and walk the half mile to the castle, or take the shuttle bus.
paragraphs.translation:
高高地矗立在悬崖顶上，廷塔杰尔城堡是传说中亚瑟王的故乡。
接待处出售的游客指南物超所值，因为它能帮助你想象出数百年前这里的景象。
你可以把车停在村里的停车场，然后步行半英里到达城堡，或者乘坐穿梭巴士。

paragraphs.text: D Pickering Castle
paragraphs.translation: D 皮克林城堡

paragraphs.text: Built by William the Conqueror, this is a great castle for children to run around in. There are lots of special events too, including a chance to come along and see some plays which are put on during the summer months. Nearby Helmsley Castle is also worth a visit.
paragraphs.translation:
由征服者威廉建造，这座城堡非常适合孩子们四处奔跑玩耍。
这里还有许多特别活动，包括有机会前来观看夏季上演的一些戏剧。
附近的赫姆斯利城堡也值得一游。

paragraphs.text: E Stokesay Castle
paragraphs.translation: E 斯托克赛城堡

paragraphs.text: A range of workshops, including music and combat, are held here during the summer. Children of all ages will enjoy learning at these and there is a guided tour which has been especially designed with younger visitors in mind.Some of them may find the dungeon quite scary though.
paragraphs.translation:
夏季期间，这里会举办一系列工作坊，包括音乐和格斗活动。
各个年龄段的孩子都会喜欢在这类活动中学习，并且这里还设有专门为年轻游客设计的导览游。
不过，有些孩子可能会觉得地牢相当可怕。

paragraphs.text: F Warwick Castle
paragraphs.translation: F 沃里克城堡

paragraphs.text: This castle is over 1,000 years old and has towers and a moat, and is just as you might imagine a castle to be.Children can even get to try on armour to see how heavy it is. At Christmas, a special market is held here - a great opportunity to look for presents and Christmas treats.
paragraphs.translation:
这座城堡已有超过1000年的历史，拥有塔楼和护城河，正如你想象中的城堡模样。
孩子们甚至可以试穿盔甲，感受它有多重。
圣诞节期间，这里会举办一个特别市场——是寻找礼物和圣诞美食的绝佳机会。

questions.reason: 直接对应题干

questions.paraphrasing: the packaging that was used -> the original packaging
evidence: Please retain the original packaging (and damaged items, if not sent to us) as we may need to inspect them.

questions.analysis: 题干指出若你是某类人，须在寄件后三个月内提出延误索赔。原文在‘Time restrictions’部分说明：‘Claims for delayed items must be submitted within 3 months of the date they were posted if the claim is made by the sender’，因此此处应填‘sender’，与题干逻辑完全吻合。
questions.reason: 直接对应题干
questions.location_analysis: 题干 if you are the sender，原文 if the claim is mad...
questions.paraphrasing: if you are the sender -> if the claim is made by the sender
evidence: Claims for delayed items must be submitted within 3 months of the date they were posted if the claim is made by the sender, or within 1 month of receipt if the claim is made by the recipient of the item.

sentence_translations.translation: 莎士比亚在创作他最著名的戏剧之一《麦克白》时，以格拉姆斯城堡为背景，而伊丽莎白王太后正是在这里长大的。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is also rumoured to have a secret chamber in the walls of the castle.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，有传闻称城堡的墙壁内有一个秘密房间。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are many ghost tales associated with this castle, which will capture the imagination of younger visitors.
sentence_translations.translation: 与这座城堡相关的众多鬼怪故事会激发年轻游客的想象力。

sentence_translations.sentence: C Tintagel Castle
sentence_translations.translation: C 廷塔杰尔城堡

sentence_translations.sentence: High up on the cliff tops, Tintagel Castle is the legendary home of King Arthur.
sentence_translations.translation: 高高地矗立在悬崖顶上，廷塔杰尔城堡是传说中亚瑟王的故乡。

sentence_translations.sentence: The visitor's guide on sale at the reception is well worth the money, as it can help you to visualise what it would have been like hundreds of years ago.
sentence_translations.translation: 接待处出售的游客指南物超所值，因为它能帮助你想象出数百年前这里的景象。

sentence_translations.sentence: You can park in the village car park and walk the half mile to the castle, or take the shuttle bus.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以把车停在村里的停车场，然后步行半英里到达城堡，或者乘坐穿梭巴士。

sentence_translations.sentence: D Pickering Castle
sentence_translations.translation: D 皮克林城堡

sentence_translations.sentence: Built by William the Conqueror, this is a great castle for children to run around in.
sentence_translations.translation: 由征服者威廉建造，这座城堡非常适合孩子们四处奔跑玩耍。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are lots of special events too, including a chance to come along and see some plays which are put on during the summer months.
sentence_translations.translation: 这里还有许多特别活动，包括有机会前来观看夏季上演的一些戏剧。

sentence_translations.sentence: Nearby Helmsley Castle is also worth a visit.
sentence_translations.translation: 附近的赫姆斯利城堡也值得一游。

sentence_translations.sentence: E Stokesay Castle
sentence_translations.translation: E 斯托克赛城堡

sentence_translations.sentence: A range of workshops, including music and combat, are held here during the summer.
sentence_translations.translation: 夏季期间，这里会举办一系列工作坊，包括音乐和格斗活动。

sentence_translations.sentence: Children of all ages will enjoy learning at these and there is a guided tour which has been especially designed with younger visitors in mind.
sentence_translations.translation: 各个年龄段的孩子都会喜欢在这类活动中学习，并且这里还设有专门为年轻游客设计的导览游。

sentence_translations.sentence: Some of them may find the dungeon quite scary though.
sentence_translations.translation: 不过，有些孩子可能会觉得地牢相当可怕。

sentence_translations.sentence: F Warwick Castle
sentence_translations.translation: F 沃里克城堡

sentence_translations.sentence: This castle is over 1,000 years old and has towers and a moat, and is just as you might imagine a castle to be.
sentence_translations.translation: 这座城堡已有超过1000年的历史，拥有塔楼和护城河，正如你想象中的城堡模样。

sentence_translations.sentence: Children can even get to try on armour to see how heavy it is.
sentence_translations.translation: 孩子们甚至可以试穿盔甲，感受它有多重。

sentence_translations.sentence: At Christmas, a special market is held here - a great opportunity to look for presents and Christmas treats.
sentence_translations.translation: 圣诞节期间，这里会举办一个特别市场——是寻找礼物和圣诞美食的绝佳机会。

paragraphs.text: A
North Sydney Council recognises the importance of balancing the demands of your work with the demands of your personal life.
paragraphs.translation: 北悉尼议会认识到平衡工作需求与个人生活需求的重要性。

paragraphs.text: B

The standard working week for full-time council employees is 35 hours for 'Indoor Staff' and 38 hours for 'Outdoor Staff' , worked over 5 days. Indoor staff are able to access the benefit of flexi time. A number of these occasionally work from home where appropriate - an example of an initiative that can provide flexibility at certain stages of an employee's career.
paragraphs.translation:
议会全职员工的标准工作周为‘室内员工’35小时，‘室外员工’38小时，分布在5天内完成。
室内员工可以享受弹性工作时间的福利。
其中一些员工偶尔在适当情况下居家办公——这是一项能够在员工职业生涯特定阶段提供灵活性的举措示例。
议会全职员工的标准工作周为‘室内员工’35小时，‘室外员工’38小时，工作分布在5天内。
室内员工能够享受弹性工作时间的福利。
其中一些人偶尔会在适当情况下在家办公——这是一个能够在员工职业生涯的特定阶段提供灵活性的举措示例。

paragraphs.text: C

Staff are entitled to 3 weeks per annum sick or carer's leave. In addition to the normal parental leave/maternity leave provisions,women who have completed 12 months of continuous service can access a total of 9 weeks' maternity leave that can be taken either as 9 weeks at full pay or as 18 weeks at half pay.
paragraphs.translation:
员工每年有权享受3周的病假或护理假。
除正常育儿假/产假规定外，连续服务满12个月的女性员工可享受总共9周的产假，可以选择全薪休假9周或半薪休假18周。
除了正常的育儿假/产假规定外，连续服务满12个月的女性员工可以享受共计9周的产假，可选择全薪休假9周或半薪休假18周。

paragraphs.text: D
The annual entitlement to paid holidays is 20 days, pro-rata for part-time. After 5 years of continuous service, employees are entitled to 6.5 weeks Long Service Leave (LSL).
paragraphs.translation:
每年带薪假期为20天，兼职员工按比例计算。
连续服务满5年后，员工有权享受6.5周的长服务假。
带薪年假每年为20天，兼职员工按比例计算。
连续服务5年之后，员工有权享受6.5周的长服务假（LSL）。

paragraphs.text: Our Financial Advice Program is conducted in partnership with FuturePlus Financial Services. We provide the services of advisors specialising in pensions, and all our employees are given the opportunity to meet them as part of the induction process.
paragraphs.translation:
我们的财务建议计划是与FuturePlus金融服务公司合作开展的。
我们提供专门从事养老金咨询的服务人员，所有员工在入职培训过程中都有机会与他们见面。
我们的财务咨询项目是与FuturePlus金融服务公司合作开展的。
我们提供专门从事养老金咨询的顾问服务，所有员工均有机会在入职培训期间与他们会面。

paragraphs.text: E

The Employee Assistance Program(EAP) is a counselling service provided at no charge to all employees and their families.The service is available by phone or face to face. The EAP provides registered psychologists for employees wishing to discuss work or non-work matters confidentially. Employees can also access information, such as articles and self assessments, online via eapdirect.
paragraphs.translation:
员工援助计划是一项免费向所有员工及其家属提供的咨询服务。
该服务可通过电话或面对面方式获得。
员工援助计划为希望私下讨论工作或非工作事务的员工提供注册心理学家。
员工还可以通过eapdirect在线获取文章和自我评估等信息。
员工援助计划(EAP)是一项向所有员工及其家属免费提供的咨询服务。
EAP为希望保密讨论工作或非工作事务的员工提供注册心理学家。
员工还可以通过eapdirect在线获取信息，例如文章和自我评估。

paragraphs.text: Registering As An Apprentice
paragraphs.translation: 注册成为学徒

paragraphs.text: If you are keen to acquire new skills and learn best through 'hands-on' experiences, then registered apprenticeship is a good option for you. These programmes always involve work experience as well as classroom instruction and produce workers skilled in the occupation. There is a written contract to be signed by the apprentice and the employer, which acknowledges their joint commitment to the training process. This contract is approved and registered by the New York State Department of Labor.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你渴望获得新技能并通过‘实践’经验学习效果最佳，那么注册学徒制对你来说是一个不错的选择。
这些项目始终包含工作经验和课堂教学，培养出熟练掌握该职业技能的工人。
学徒和雇主需签署一份书面合同，确认双方对培训过程的共同承诺。
该合同由纽约州劳工部批准和注册。
如果你渴望掌握新技能，且通过‘亲身实践’的学习方式效果最佳，那么注册学徒制对你来说是一个不错的选择。
这些项目通常包含工作经验和课堂教学，并培养出精通该职业的工人。
学徒和雇主需签署一份书面合同，该合同确认了双方对培训过程的共同承诺。
这份合同需经纽约州劳工部批准并注册。

paragraphs.text: How Do I Qualify?
paragraphs.translation:
我如何符合资格？
我如何获得资格？

paragraphs.text: First of all you must meet the employer's minimum qualifications. This could be a high school diploma or the equivalent.However, some employers will ask for specific high school courses, prior experience, or occupationally related courses.
paragraphs.translation:
首先，你必须满足雇主的最低资格要求。
这可能是高中文凭或同等学历。
然而，一些雇主会要求特定的高中课程、先前经验或职业相关课程。
首先，你必须达到雇主的入职最低要求。
这可能是一份高中文凭或同等学力证明。
然而，有些雇主要求上过特定的高中课程、具备先前工作经验或修读过职业相关课程。

paragraphs.text: What Is My Training Like?
paragraphs.translation: 我的培训是什么样的？

paragraphs.text: Training for each apprenticeable occupation is conducted according to a training outline that has been standardized for the occupation. This assures that apprentices across the state have the same sets of basic competencies and skills.At the successful completion of each registered apprenticeship,the Department of Labor awards the apprentice a 'Certificate of Completion', which is a nationally recognized credential.
paragraphs.translation:
每个可学徒职业的培训都按照为该职业标准化的培训大纲进行。
这确保了全州的学徒拥有相同的基本能力和技能。
在成功完成每个注册学徒制后，劳工部会向学徒颁发‘结业证书’，这是一项全国认可的资质证明。
针对每一可学徒的职业，培训均按照该职业标准化后的培训大纲进行。
这确保了全州的学徒具备相同的基本能力和技能。
在成功完成每个注册学徒项目后，劳工部会授予学徒一份“结业证书”，这是一份全国认可的资格证明。

paragraphs.text: The length of time it takes you to learn the skills of the occupation depends upon two things: the standard training outline and your aptitude. Each trade has a definite term of training, listed in years. As a registered apprentice, you may progress according to that established training term, or you may become skilled more quickly or more slowly. It may even be that you start your apprenticeship with credit toward the goal. Your employer may choose to award you this for previous working experience in the occupation, or for prior coursework related to the occupation.
paragraphs.translation:
学习职业所需技能的时间取决于两件事：标准培训大纲和你的能力。
每个行业都有固定的培训期限，以年为单位列出。
作为注册学徒，你可以按照既定的培训期限进步，也可能更快或更慢地掌握技能。
甚至可能你开始学徒时已获得部分学分，朝着目标迈进。
你的雇主可能会根据你之前在该职业的工作经验或相关课程学习，选择授予你这些学分。
掌握该职业技能所需的时间取决于两个因素：标准培训大纲和你的个人能力。
每个行业都有明确的培训年限，按年列出。
作为注册学徒，你可以按照既定的培训期限逐步进展，也可能更快或更慢地掌握技能。
甚至有可能你在开始学徒期时已获得部分学分，用于达成目标。
你的雇主可能会根据你在该行业先前的工作经验或相关的过往课程学习，给予你这些学分。

paragraphs.text: As an apprentice, you are part of the employer's workforce. You work full-time for the employer. A registered apprentice works under the guidance of more experienced craft workers called journey workers. From them, you learn the skills of the trade.As you master each skill, you become a more productive employee.
paragraphs.translation:
作为学徒，你是雇主劳动力的一部分。
你为雇主全职工作。
注册学徒在被称为熟练工的更有经验的手工艺工人的指导下工作。
从他们那里，你学习行业的技能。
随着你掌握每项技能，你成为一名更高效的员工。
作为一名学徒，你是雇主员工队伍中的一员。
注册学徒在被称为熟练工的更有经验的手工工人的指导下工作。
从他们那里，你学习这门手艺的技能。
随着你掌握每一项技能，你会成为更有生产力的员工。

paragraphs.text: At the same time as you are working, you are also required to attend classes (usually in the evenings). The location and times of these are set up by the local education agent in consultation with the employer. Your progress is tracked by you, your employer and your education provider.
paragraphs.translation:
在工作同时，你还需要参加课程（通常在晚上）。
这些课程的地点和时间由当地教育机构与雇主协商确定。
你的进步由你本人、雇主和教育机构共同跟踪记录。
在你工作的同时，你还需要参加课程（通常在晚上）。
你的进步由你自己、雇主和教育提供者共同跟踪。

paragraphs.text: Successful completion of all requirements results in your certificate.
paragraphs.translation:
成功完成所有要求后，你将获得证书。
成功完成所有要求后，您将获得证书。

For thousands of years, the Humber - an estuary formed where two major rivers, the Trent and the Ouse, meet - has been an obstacle to communications along the east coast of England, between the counties of Yorkshire to the north and Lincolnshire to the south. Before the arrival of the railways in the 19th century,water transportation was the most efficient means of moving heavy or bulk freight, and the Humber, situated at the heart of the waterway system associated with the two major rivers, was one of the chief highways of England. Its traffic brought prosperity to the settlements on its banks,particularly the city of Hull on its north bank, but the river itself tended to cut them off from some of their closest neighbours, as well as obstructing the progress of travellers moving north or south.

在19世纪铁路出现之前，水路运输是运送沉重或大宗货物最有效的方式，而亨伯位于与两条主要河流相关的水路系统中心，曾是英格兰的主要交通要道之一。

paragraphs.text: B

To cater for these local and, as time progressed, wider needs, ferries were provided across many of the streams flowing into the Humber,and in 1315, a ferry was established across the Humber itself between Hull and Lincolnshire. By 1800,this ferry had become fully integrated into the overland transport system, but the changes associated with the industrial revolution were soon to threaten its position. Increased traffic encouraged speculators to establish rival ferries between Hull and Lincolnshire, notably a service between Hull and New Holland which opened in 1826.This crossing was considerably shorter than on the existing Hull to Barton service,which closed in 1851, unable to cope with the increased competition from the rival service.

到1800年，这条渡轮已完全融入陆上运输系统，但随之而来的工业革命变革很快便威胁到它的地位。
日益增长的交通量促使投机者在赫尔和林肯郡之间开设竞争性渡轮服务，其中以1826年开通的赫尔至新荷兰航线尤为突出。
这条航线比当时现有的赫尔至巴顿航线短得多，后者因无法应对来自竞争航线的日益加剧的竞争，于1851年关闭。

paragraphs.text: C

The bridge was the outcome of over 100 years of campaigning by local interests for the construction of a bridge or tunnel across the estuary. The first major crossing proposal was a tunnel scheme in 1872.This scheme was promoted by Hull merchants and businesses dissatisfied with the service provided by the New Holland ferry crossing.Over the next 100 years, a variety of proposals were put forward in an effort to bridge the Humber. In 1928, a plan was drawn up by Hull City Council to build a multi-span bridge four miles west of Hull.However, the scheme was dropped after being hit by the financial woes of the Great Depression of the late 1920s and early 1930s.

这一方案由对纽荷兰渡轮服务不满的赫尔商人和企业推动。
在接下来的100年里，人们提出了各种方案，试图在亨伯河上建桥。
1928年，赫尔市议会制定了一项计划，在赫尔以西4英里处建造一座多跨桥。
然而，该计划在遭受20世纪20年代末和30年代初大萧条的经济困境后放弃了。

paragraphs.text: D

Government approval for the construction of a suspension bridge was finally granted in 1959, although it was not until 1973 that work finally began.The reasons why a suspension bridge was chosen were twofold. Firstly, the Humber has a shifting bed, and the navigable channel along which a craft can travel is always changing; a suspension bridge with no support piers in mid-stream would not obstruct the estuary.Secondly, because of the geology and topography of the area,the cost of constructing a tunnel would have been excessive.

paragraphs.text: E

Work on the construction proceeded for eight years, during which time many thousands of tonnes of steel and concrete were used and upwards of one thousand workers and staff were employed at times of peak activity. The designers had been responsible for two other major suspension bridges in Britain but, with a total span of 2,220 m, or almost a mile and a half, the Humber was going to be the longest suspension bridge in the world. Nowadays designers have computers, but back then everything was done with slide rules and calculators. The towers were concrete rather than the usual steel, since concrete was cheaper and would blend in better with the setting.The bridge was designed to stand for 120 years.

Malcolm Stockwell, the bridgemaster, recalls that when the bridge first opened, there wasn't a great deal of interest in it. sentence_translations.sentence: For thousands of years, the Humber - an estuary formed where two major rivers, the Trent and the Ouse, meet - has been an obstacle to communications along the east coast of England, between the counties of Yorkshire to the north and Lincolnshire to the south.

sentence_translations.sentence: However, the scheme was dropped after being hit by the financial woes of the Great Depression of the late 1920s and early 1930s.

sentence_translations.sentence: The bridge was the outcome of over 100 years of campaigning by local interests for the construction of a bridge or tunnel across the estuary.
